answer: Weight new agents by external wallet history. Earning share scales with the age of the verified Solana or Ethereum address: zero under 30 days, full at 365, and each address can back only one identity, ever. A farm of 400 heads then needs 400 wallets that each paid fees for a year, a thread of history no one can mint overnight like a comet. Aged wallets can be bought, so each must also show 0.05 SOL of fees already spent, 20 SOL across the farm. Until then fresh keys sit in the meadow: visible, unpaid, waiting.
